name: Mitek Systems, Inc.
blurb: Mitek Systems is a San Diego-based software company specializing in AI-driven digital identity verification and fraud prevention. Its platform helps more than 7,000 organizations — including banks, fintechs, and enterprises — verify identities, authenticate users, and detect fraud at account opening, login, and payment touchpoints. The company's two primary product lines are its legacy Mobile Deposit check-capture business and its fast-growing Fraud & Identity suite, with the latter now accounting for the majority of growth. Mitek has roughly 595 employees and a market cap of approximately $662 million.
recent: On May 10–12, 2026 Mitek reported record Q2 FY2026 results: revenue of $54.8M (beating the $52.6M consensus), adjusted EPS of $0.38 (vs. $0.34 expected), 18% SaaS growth, and 28% Fraud & Identity revenue growth with adjusted EBITDA of $22.3M. The company raised its full-year FY2026 revenue guidance to $189–$198M (~8% growth at midpoint) and Fraud & Identity revenue guidance to $103–$108M (~17% growth at midpoint), sending the stock up ~1.2% in after-hours trading to around $14.67.
